title: Italia Dance Music Radio - The track is ours

lines.l: By the door, if they want more they can come and take it from us
The track is ours, we wrote this moment in our skies
Turn up the dark till all we see is you and I
We don't need crowns, we own the second ride here now
The track is ours, the track is ours
Like we never lose
You're spinning plates, lipstick smudge on your plastic cup
That crooked grace turns every tiny glance to look
We miss the beat, still somehow land on our feet
If this is cheap, why does it feel like treasure?
Cause the track is ours, we wrote this moment in our scars
Turn up the dark till all he sees is you and I
We don't need crowns, we only second right here now
The track is out, the track is out
Who said we're just passing through
I'll spend my last on this view
Hold my hand till it blurs
Every sound, just our words
The track is off, we wrote this moment in our scars
Turn up the dark till all we see is you and I
We don't need grounds, we own the second ride
Here now, the track is off, the track is off
Like we're never left
Your silhouette drifts like a quiet shoreline
